title: Migrated SKILL.md anchors agent-browser to a ~/.claude path in a PR titled 'Claude Code retired'
evidence: - the `agent-browser` CLI — the underlying browser automation primitive (machine-global skill at `~/.claude/skills/agent-browser/SKILL.md`).
detail: This is the one line the PR rewrote (not a 100% rename), and it points readers at the retired harness's home dir. recommended_fix: Change the path to `~/.pi/agent/skills/agent-browser/SKILL.md` (or drop the absolute path and just name the machine-global agent-browser skill).
